description: Persistent knowledge-graph memory for AI agents, with local semantic search. No API keys.
name: io.github.Sathvik-1007/graphmem-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Path to the SQLite database file. Defaults to .graphmem/graph.db relative to the working directory.
environmentVariables.name: GRAPHMEM_DB_PATH

environmentVariables.description: sentence-transformers model ID used for semantic search. Defaults to all-MiniLM-L6-v2, downloaded on first use.
environmentVariables.name: GRAPHMEM_EMBEDDING_MODEL

environmentVariables.description: Maximum entities visited by a single graph traversal. Defaults to 5000.
environmentVariables.name: GRAPHMEM_TRAVERSAL_NODE_BUDGET

environmentVariables.description: Logging verbosity: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, or CRITICAL. Defaults to WARNING.
environmentVariables.name: GRAPHMEM_LOG_LEVEL

title: Graph-Mem
